mechanics.claim: The bolt explodes on hitting an enemy, dealing damage to nearby enemies within the explosion radius.
mechanics.quote: fires a bolt of spikes in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Kha'Zix heals only if he himself is within the explosion radius when it detonates.
mechanics.quote: '''Kha'Zix''' {{tip|heals}} himself if he is within the explosion.

mechanics.claim: When evolved, the ability fires three clusters, but hitting the same target with multiple clusters does not deal extra damage or grant extra healing.
mechanics.quote: Multiple explosions do not deal additional damage against the same target nor provide '''Kha'Zix''' with extra healing.

mechanics.claim: The spell can be blocked by a spell shield.
The cast time ends before the effect (missile fires) begins, per the standard cast-time-end effect timing.
